newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nine held in France on suspected Basque ETA links.
newsitem.headline: Nine held in France on suspected Basque ETA links.

text.p: Nine people suspected of providing logistical support for the Basque ETA separatist movement were detained in southern France on Tuesday, police said.
Searches were also carried out in Bayonne and Arcangues in French Basque country but yielded nothing significant, the sources said.
"It was a routine operation," a police spokesman said.
The operations were part of an investigation of Basque separatist guerrilla activity in France led by Paris anti-terrorist magistrate Laurence Le Vert, the sources said.
The ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed some 800 people since 1968 in its violent campaign for an independent Basque state.

Despite numerous recent arrests in France, Spanish Interior Minister Jaime Mayor Oreja said in February that the separatist movement's political and military leadership was located in France and had yet to be dismantled.
